mapper.select: select cashier_url, expires_at, merchant_no, id, payment_order_no, order_no, student_code, student_name, phone, product_name, payment_amount, payment_channel, payment_status, unique_order_no, last_error_msg, created_at, updated_at from sale_payment_order where payment_order_no = #{paymentOrderNo} limit 1

select cashier_url, expires_at, merchant_no, id, payment_order_no, order_no, student_code, student_name, phone, product_name, payment_amount, payment_channel, payment_status, unique_order_no, last_error_msg, created_at, updated_at from sale_payment_order where order_no = #{orderNo} order by id desc limit 1

select cashier_url, expires_at, merchant_no, id, payment_order_no, order_no, student_code, student_name, phone, product_name, payment_amount, payment_channel, payment_status, unique_order_no, last_error_msg, created_at, updated_at from sale_payment_order where unique_order_no = #{uniqueOrderNo} limit 1
mapper.update: update sale_payment_order set payment_status = #{paymentStatus}, unique_order_no = #{uniqueOrderNo}, cashier_url = #{cashierUrl}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, last_error_msg = #{lastErrorMsg}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{id} and payment_status = 'PROCESSING'
update sale_payment_order set payment_status = #{paymentStatus}, last_error_msg = #{lastErrorMsg}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and payment_status in ('INIT', 'PROCESSING')

update sale_payment_order set unique_order_no = #{uniqueOrderNo}, payment_status = #{paymentStatus}, last_error_msg = #{lastErrorMsg}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{id} and payment_status != 'PAY_SUCCESS'
